objective: Make Hina's current local chat concise and direct by default, while defining a provenance-safe future training slice for short, playful Vietnamese VTuber responses without copying Neuro-sama private models, datasets or transcripts.
non_goals: Do not fine-tune or modify model weights in this slice.
Do not scrape, transcribe or copy Neuro-sama streams, catchphrases or proprietary dialogue datasets.
Do not post-process or cut a generated sentence; the provider token budget remains explicitly configurable for detailed tasks.
Do not auto-train from raw owner, viewer or public chat.
Do not modify the speech, memory, perception or safety-policy implementations.
contracts: Hina answers directly in one or two short sentences and usually at most 45 Vietnamese words; up to three sentences and 80 words are allowed when context is needed, unless the owner requests detail, code, a list or a step-by-step explanation.
Hina does not repeat the question, add generic disclaimers, introduce herself unprompted or append an offer to help when the direct answer is complete.
Safety truthfulness, capability boundaries and explicit owner formatting requests override brevity.
The local gateway default output budget is 192 tokens and remains configurable through HINA_MODEL_MAX_TOKENS.
Future style training uses immutable consented or repository-authored data with independent safety and utility evaluation; raw public chat is never training input.
allowed_dependencies: Existing versioned PersonaSpec, model gateway configuration and text-brain unit harness.
Existing offline M11 dataset and LoRA/QLoRA roadmap contracts.
acceptance_criteria: The versioned persona prompt contains an explicit one-to-two sentence, usually <=45-word default, a three-sentence/80-word normal ceiling and clear expansion exceptions.
ModelGatewayConfig defaults to 192 output tokens, exposes the effective limit in public status and passes the value to Ollama/OpenAI-compatible requests.
Unit tests freeze the concise response contract and default token budget.
The M11 plan defines a Vietnamese concise-witty style dataset and evaluation slice without copying Neuro-sama dialogue.
Focused text-brain tests and the fast unit suite pass once.
